activity.role: Minister of State in Bouisson cabinet
activity.notes: Short-lived Bouisson cabinet 1–4 June 1935. Distinguished from his 1934 War Ministry and 1940 Minister-of-State + Deputy Premiership. Activity domain emphasis: governance.

sources.citation_text: Larousse documents his war ministry Feb 1934, Bouisson state ministry June 1935, Franco embassy and Reynaud vice premiership on 18 May 1940.
